title: RULE 17 tells every agent when to log and when to ask
asA: harness (Claude Code or Codex) that reads the managed instructions block
iWant: a static RULE 17 in guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md that names rcf feedback add for logging, describes the one-ask-per-session posture (harness hook or operator wrap-up as trigger, preview then submit --yes or defer or opt-out), and states the redaction posture
soThat: an agent under pace still follows the shape when the harness hooks are not trusted, and the same rule serves both harnesses

acceptanceCriteria.description: guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md gains RULE 17 with the wording specified in design section 3.4. pnpm run build:managed regenerates the block hash and harness-template.md so rcf doctor doctor-agent-instructions and gen-managed-artefacts stay byte-consistent. The wording is static (no version numbers, no dates) and names all four verbs (preview, submit --yes, defer, opt-out). A byte-exact template test loads the shipped block and asserts the RULE 17 slice is byte-for-byte identical to the design-section-3.4 fixture stored in test/fixtures/managed/rule-17.md, so a wording drift on ship is caught.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture repository state with RULE 17 not yet added
acceptanceCriteria.when: the change is applied, pnpm run build:managed is run, and rcf doctor is run
acceptanceCriteria.then: RULE 17 appears in the block file exactly as specified; the hash file changes on this release; doctor doctor-agent-instructions reports clean; a byte-exact template test asserts the RULE 17 slice of the block matches test/fixtures/managed/rule-17.md byte-for-byte

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf init writes CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with the regenerated block (RULE 17 included). The existing managed-block installation path (writeAgentInstructions) is the only touch-point; no init-time flag is added for RULE 17.
acceptanceCriteria.then: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md both contain the RULE 17 block text between the managed-block markers; the block outside the markers is untouched
